cards.name: 輕聲安撫
cards.sceneStart: 你把聲音壓低，像怕驚動什麼似的，慢慢安她。空氣裡多了一層小心翼翼，你甚至放慢了呼吸，好讓每個字都落在她聽得見、又不刺耳的距離。你沒有急著要她回應，只是把語氣墊軟，像在她旁邊舖了一塊可以暫時坐下來的地方。光在她側臉停了一下，你等她決定要收下這份安撫，還是把防線重新拉起。

cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：討論劇透

cards.name: 一起等末班
cards.sceneStart: 夜風有點涼。你們在站牌或停車場多站一會兒，誰都沒催。電影已經結束，約會卻像還卡在片尾曲裡，捨不得按停。
cards.promptHint: 約會第3章·散場不捨。
cards.visualEn: from his POV outdoor night by bus stop or parking, medium-wide, she standing BESIDE him looking at street or phone, side profile, night lights, cold air, not facing camera square
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：一起等末班

cards.name: 專櫃並肩
cards.sceneStart: 電梯叮一聲，專櫃香氣把空氣擠得甜甜的。你們停在同一面櫥窗前，為一件無關緊要的東西交換意見。購物籃邊緣，手背差一點碰上。
cards.promptHint: 約會第1章·逛街開場。
cards.visualEn: from his POV department store aisle, medium-wide, she standing at shop display slightly AHEAD, three-quarter BACK looking into glass showcase, mall lights, shopping bags optional, not facing camera
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：專櫃並肩

cards.name: 問你合不合
cards.sceneStart: 試衣間外你假裝研究價牌。門開一條縫，她探出頭問合不合身——距離近到能聞見新衣漿味。走廊鏡子把你們都收進去。
cards.promptHint: 約會第2章·試衣。
cards.visualEn: from his POV fitting-room corridor, medium shot, she PEERING from door at ANGLE, door frame visible, hallway depth behind him, three-quarter face at door gap, not centered frontal portrait
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：問你合不合

cards.name: 扶梯並排
cards.sceneStart: 手扶梯把人送往下一層。你們並排站著，話題被樓層廣告打斷又接上。她的手扶在扶手上，指尖離你的手只有一點點。
cards.promptHint: 約會第2章·扶梯並排。
cards.visualEn: from his POV on escalator, medium shot, she standing on SAME step BESIDE or one step ahead, body facing escalator direction PROFILE, hand on rail, mall atrium depth, not looking at viewer
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：扶梯並排

cards.name: 分食同一杯
cards.sceneStart: 美食街桌子很小，兩杯變成一杯比較划算。吸管換邊時誰都沒說破。她把下一口讓給你，像把約會的節奏也讓了一半。
cards.promptHint: 約會第3章·分食。
cards.visualEn: from his POV food court table, medium shot, she seated ACROSS or 45-degree angle, three-quarter face over table, shared cup between them, background food court blur, conversational table distance
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：分食同一杯

cards.name: 幫她提袋子
cards.sceneStart: 結帳後袋子換手。你自然接過，她愣了一下才道謝。塑料袋提把勒進掌心，比剛才任何櫥窗都更像「我們一起逛完了」。
cards.promptHint: 約會第3章·提袋收尾。
cards.visualEn: from his POV mall corridor walking out, medium-wide, she beside him, he carries bags in foreground edge, she three-quarter SIDE looking slightly down smiling, exit light ahead
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：幫她提袋子

cards.name: 地下街出口
cards.sceneStart: 往出口的人潮變密。她側身讓你走在外側，像習慣又像試探。地上街的光灌進來時，這場逛街約會有了明確的句點——也有「下次再來」的縫。
cards.promptHint: 約會第3章·出口。
cards.visualEn: from his POV underground mall exit ramp, medium-wide, she walking toward daylight exit slightly ahead SIDE VIEW, he on outer side, street light pouring in, not frontal
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：地下街出口

cards.name: 踩浪散步
cards.sceneStart: 沙子還帶著白天的熱。浪一來，腳踝就被涼意咬住。你們沿著水線走，鞋子提在手上，談話被風吹成斷句。腳印被下一波抹平。
cards.promptHint: 約會第1章·海邊開場。
cards.visualEn: from his POV walking wet sand shoreline, medium-wide, she BESIDE him PROFILE, looking at waves not camera, wind hair, ocean horizon, shoes in hand, cinematic walk
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：踩浪散步

cards.name: 浪潑到笑聲
cards.sceneStart: 浪忽然大了一檔，水花濺上小腿與衣角。她短促叫了一聲，笑聲被海風扯散。你伸手擦她頰邊的水珠，指尖停得比必要久了一點。
cards.promptHint: 約會第2章·被浪潑到。
cards.visualEn: from his POV on beach, medium shot, she HALF-TURNED laughing after splash, three-quarter back-to-side, looking at waves or him over shoulder, wet lower clothes still covered, ocean spray
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：浪潑到笑聲

cards.name: 坐在防波堤
cards.sceneStart: 防波堤的石頭被曬得溫熱。你們並肩坐下，腿懸在半空，看浪一下下撞上來。話題變慢，海的聲音把約會填滿。
cards.promptHint: 約會第2章·防波堤並坐。
cards.visualEn: from his POV on seawall rocks, medium-wide, she sitting BESIDE him legs dangling, both facing ocean PROFILE, backs partly to camera optional, sea spray, calm
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：坐在防波堤

cards.name: 夕陽把影子拉長
cards.sceneStart: 太陽貼近海平面，影子被拉得特別長。你們的影子先牽在一起，人還假裝沒有。誰先說「該走了」都會破壞這一點剛好的溫度。
cards.promptHint: 約會第3章·夕陽。
cards.visualEn: from his POV beach golden hour, medium-wide, she standing BESIDE looking at sunset HORIZON, three-quarter BACK silhouette, long shadows, ocean, not facing camera
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：夕陽把影子拉長

cards.name: 撿一顆石頭
cards.sceneStart: 她彎腰撿起一顆圓石頭，塞進你手心說「記念」。石頭還帶著海水的涼。你握著它，比握著任何紀念品都更像今天有發生過。
cards.promptHint: 約會第3章·小記念。
cards.visualEn: from his POV beach, medium shot, she crouched or bent picking stone, three-quarter side, offering stone toward camera hand, face looking at stone then soft glance, ocean behind
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：撿一顆石頭

cards.name: 風變大了
cards.sceneStart: 傍晚風忽然變大，她把頭髮撥開，往你身側靠半步擋風。沒說要走，也沒說要留。海的噪音裡，這半步就是結局。
cards.promptHint: 約會第3章·靠風收尾。
cards.visualEn: from his POV windy beach evening, medium shot, she stepping CLOSER from side against wind, three-quarter profile, hair windblown, looking toward sea or his shoulder, not frontal passport
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：風變大了

cards.name: 門關上之後
cards.sceneStart: 房卡冰涼，門在身後扣上時，外面的規則暫時失效。房裡只開一盞燈。你們都清楚這是約會走到私密的那一步，只是誰先把沉默撕開。
cards.promptHint: 約會第1章·旅館進房。
cards.visualEn: from his POV just inside hotel room doorway, medium-wide showing room depth, she standing A FEW STEPS INTO the room back three-quarter, looking at room or window not camera, warm lamp, door frame edge, not face-on
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：門關上之後

cards.name: 窗邊的夜景
cards.sceneStart: 窗簾拉開一點，城市燈火在玻璃上跳動。你們靠在窗邊，話題比白天更低、更真。她的肩膀輕輕碰上你的。
cards.promptHint: 約會第2章·窗邊。
cards.visualEn: from his POV hotel room, medium shot, she at WINDOW looking OUT at night city lights, three-quarter BACK, city bokeh, optional soft head turn, warm interior, not facing camera
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：窗邊的夜景

cards.name: 泡茶的空檔
cards.sceneStart: 熱水壺響了。兩人分到馬克杯，坐在床沿或沙發角，像故意用喝茶把節奏放慢。蒸汽模糊了視線的一小塊。
cards.promptHint: 約會第2章·喝茶放慢。
cards.visualEn: from his POV hotel room, medium shot, she sitting on bed EDGE or sofa ANGLED 45 degrees, three-quarter view, tea cup steam, space between them, lamp light, not passport frontal
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：泡茶的空檔

cards.name: 燈只開一盞
cards.sceneStart: 你把主燈關掉，只留床頭那盞。光變軟，距離也變近。誰都沒有下一步指令，空氣卻比進門時更密——結局可以是擁抱，也可以是並肩坐到沉默變甜。
cards.promptHint: 約會第3章·燈光親密（仍可非色情）。
cards.visualEn: from his POV dim hotel room bedside lamp only, medium shot, she sitting or standing mid-room three-quarter, soft shadows, body not square to camera, intimate atmosphere fully clothed
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：燈只開一盞

cards.name: 說今晚就到這
cards.sceneStart: 她先開口，語氣輕：「……今天這樣就好。」不是拒絕，是把界線畫在甜蜜的位置。你應了，房間裡的緊張卸下一半，留下的是可以被記住的約會完整形狀。
cards.promptHint: 約會第3章·溫柔收束。
cards.visualEn: from his POV hotel room, medium shot, she seated angled toward him three-quarter, gentle sincere expression, table or bed between partial, warm light, conversational not frontal mugshot
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：說今晚就到這

cards.name: 出門前整理衣領
cards.sceneStart: 離開前，她伸手幫你整理衣領或頭髮。動作很短，卻像蓋章：這場私密的約會結束了，外面的世界要重新開機。門把轉動的聲音很輕。
cards.promptHint: 約會第3章·出門整理。
cards.visualEn: from his POV near hotel door interior, medium shot, she close, hands near his collar, looking at COLLAR not camera first, three-quarter face, door behind, fully clothed exit moment
cards.visualZh: 場面取景（禁止正對鏡頭）：出門前整理衣領
